title: Factoriality of normal projective varieties
summary: For a normal projective variety $X$, the $\mathbb Q$-factoriality defect $σ(X)$ is defined to be the rank of the quotient of the group of Weil divisors by the subgroup of Cartier ones. We prove an improvement of a topological formula of S.G. Park and M. Popa asserting that $σ(X)\le h^{2n-2}(X)-h^2(X)$ by assuming only 1-semi-rational singularities instead of rational singularities, and the equality holds in the 2-semi-rational case.
